title: Comparisons and preferences
function: Compare and express preferences with nuance

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn advanced comparison structures and how to express preferences using both, either, neither and question tags.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. She is not as tall as her sister. Both films were good. I do not like either. Neither of them came. You are Spanish, are not you? Notice the different structures.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: This book is ___ interesting ___ that one.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Compare two friends or family members using both, either, neither.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: Question tags use the opposite auxiliary.
